Coram : BHUSHAN RAMKRISHNA GAVAI, ARAVIND KUMAR, PRASHANT KUMAR MISHRA
Issue for Consideration Matter pertains to criteria issued for the identification of private ‘forest’ land in the State of Goa. Headnotes Environmental laws – Forests – Criteria issued by the State of Goa for the identification of the State of Goa – Challenge to, by the appellant seeking change in the criteria: Held: Existing criteria for identification of private forests in the State of Goa are adequate and valid, thus, requires no alteration – Criteria of the canopy density of 0.4 and minimum area of 5 ha if
Decision Date : 24-01-2024 | Case No : WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) No. 202/1995 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 3 Judges
